sanskrit:
सुखमात्यन्तिकं यत्तद् बुद्धिग्राह्यमतीन्द्रियम् ।
वेत्ति यत्र न चैवायं स्थितश्चलति तत्त्वतः ॥ ६-२१॥
iast:
sukhamātyantikaṃ yattad buddhigrāhyamatīndriyam
vetti yatra na caivāyaṃ sthitaścalati tattvataḥ 6-21
translation: When he (the YOGI ) feels that Infinite bliss — which can be grasped by the (pure) intellect and which transcends the senses — wherein established he never moves from the Reality;
